reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issueTitle 'Telescreen: sensitive-data retention violation monitoring, Sentry-style reporting, and DB-backed incident/AI workflow engine' (no GitHub issue number); run opus-luna-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-341, run B
reviewContext.userProblem: Finish Telescreen v1: a Sentry-pattern UI that works against the real API and in a masked mock mode, an assembled Bureau whose `telescreen serve` serves API and UI, and runnable compose examples with documentation, without ever exposing raw sensitive values.
requiredOutcomes: UI per design-ui-sentry.md (tokens light/dark, chonky buttons, rail + panel shell, issue list/detail, all pages restyled) limited to the accepted API (8.1).
UI client types equal the router serializers; mock API mode renders every page with masked fixtures only.
telescreen serve serves the API and the built UI; CLI, e2e and leak tests pass offline.
README, compose reconciliation; mise run ci and the web gates pass; screenshot smoke saved under tmp/.
nonGoals: Any backend endpoint, parameter or response field change.
Copying Sentry code, assets, icons, names or brand colors.
constraints: Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no Any/object/dict, no **kwargs, no type-ignore.
Raw detected values never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; fixtures masked only.
Only p30 runs bun add/install without --frozen-lockfile; nobody edits pyproject.toml/uv.lock.
Python files < 1000 lines, plan files < 400 lines, web files < 400 lines.
Fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; offline-skipped integration tests are not risks (conventions 7a).
Builds go to /tmp; never into src/web/dist.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Router serializers are authoritative; p31 aligns types instead of adapting wire data, so mock mode cannot hide real-backend breakage.
Mock switch is a constant-folded import.meta.env check with a dynamic import, so production bundles carry no fixtures.
UI located only via TELESCREEN_WEB_DIST; the wheel stays node-free.
intentionalTradeoffs: Sentry patterns needing data the API lacks are omitted (design 8.1).
Docked assistant panel replaced by navigation to /assistant?context=.
supportedEdgeCases: Empty states: no matching issues, zero unresolved, no collectors (design-ui-sentry.md).
Invalid workflow text shows 'Fix validation errors to preview' instead of a graph.
Bulk actions report per-issue failures in a toast with counts.
TELESCREEN_WEB_DIST without index.html: serve exits 3; unknown /api/ paths return JSON not_found, never the SPA fallback; unset serves API only (design 8.6).
Run polling only while a run is running or waiting.
Screenshot smoke without a local Chrome/Chromium exits non-zero and is recorded as a verification gap (design 8.5).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Select-all-N-matching and multi-page bulk confirm (API returns no total count).
Ignore with duration or until-regressed; Rescan now; Set priority; escalation tier and due time on issue detail (design 8.1).
Offline verification of docker compose config and the Docker bun build (static tests/examples checks only).
OIDC SSO (bearer API tokens only in v1).
